tasks.spec: APIRouter: /tracker/transactions (GET, filters date_from/date_to/category/account_id), /tracker/transactions/{id} (GET/PUT/DELETE, hard delete allowed), /tracker/categories, /tracker/recurring, /tracker/trends (monthly), /tracker/insights. PUT/POST validate category against shared/constants/categories (import it) -> 422 on a bad value. All via services.db.connect().

RecurringDetector (same payee + ~30-day cadence + amount within 10%), LeakFinder (leak-of-the-week: largest avoidable category delta vs trailing median), BudgetDrift. __init__(self, llm_client). Deterministic; llm only for the insight sentence.

Filterable transaction table with inline edit + delete via useSubmit (so Overview updates with no manual refresh), a category breakdown (hand-rolled SVG bars), a monthly trend line (computed path), a recurring list, an insights panel. Fetch via useFinanceData.

Controlled form: account select, date, description, amount (negative=expense), type select (from HOLDING? no - TRANSACTION_TYPES), category select populated from shared/constants/categories TRANSACTION_CATEGORIES. Submits via useSubmit to /api/finance/import/manual {entity:'transaction',...}. onSaved callback.
